thread:
maya: Quick sync — Acme asked for a private pilot with HSM-backed keys, pre-warm burst to 200 concurrent sessions, and canary traffic siphon to their EU region. They want a June SLA demo. Is that feasible?
sam: June feels tight given infra + security checks. Need concrete list of blockers.
kevin: From runtime side: model variant + quantization parity across private vs hosted is the big one. We need to confirm the quantized weights behave identically for their prompt sets.
priya: Infra: pre-warm to 200 concurrent sessions requires reserved GPUs and pre-warm scripts. Also network egress to EU region — we'll need routing and capacity reservations.
laura: Security: HSM integration plus customer audit will add 3–4 weeks if we queue a full pen test. If they accept scoped attestations and an explicit STS flow we can shave it. Need exact KMS/HSM vendor.
annika: I talked to Acme; they prefer AWS CloudHSM, but are open to our KMS with customer-managed keys. Main ask is separation of key material.
raj: From SRE: pre-warm autoscaling + warm pool lifecycle is doable but we need a playbook for cold starts and fallback to hosted models. Also define failure SLOs for pre-warm.
maya: Ok — action items: 1) list of technical deltas (runtime, infra, security) 2) launch gating criteria 3) owners for each gate. Can each of you drop the delta list in this thread by EOD?
sam: Runtime deltas (draft):
- quantization parity tests (1000 prompt evals)
- KV cache warmup behavior (session affinity)
- model variant fallback (smaller fp16 when quantized fails)
- telemetry hooks for token-level latency
kevin: Runtime follow-up: Add compatibility matrix for our optimized kernels vs customer's HW (pinned to GPU family) and a regression signal for perplexity + hallucination on their eval set.
priya: Infra deltas:
- reserved GPU pool sizing (200 pre-warm + buffer)
- VPC peering and egress routing to EU region
- pre-warm orchestration playbook + automation (ansible/k8s job)
- burst billing projection
laura: Security deltas:
- HSM integration plan + KMS mapping
- minimum audit artifacts (KMS logs, key access policy)
- scoped pen test vs attestation decision
- compliance checklist (GDPR data flow)
annika: Customer asks to omit full pen test for pilot if we provide continuous audit logs and an HSM audit token. They can sign a pilot NDA.
raj: Ops gating: we require runbook + rollback steps + a canary percentage (5% -> 25% -> 100%). Also need a hot fallback model route to hosted with throttling.
maya: Proposed launch gating criteria (initial):
- infra: reserved pool + network validated (smoke pass)
- runtime: quant parity within tolerance, fallback route implemented
- security: HSM plan + audit logs provisioned, legal NDA in place
- ops: runbook + canary automation and SLIs defined
priya: Timing estimate (optimistic): infra baseline 3 weeks (reservation + routing), 1 week for automation. Can overlap with runtime tests.
sam: Runtime estimate: 2 weeks for parity tests and fallback wiring if we prioritize.
laura: Security estimate: 2–4 weeks depending on pen test choice. If Acme accepts attestation, 1 week to wire logs and policies.
maya: So realistically June demo is possible only if Acme accepts attestation + we start immediately and run parallel work. Otherwise target shifts to July.
kevin: Risk notes: model quality regressions when switching quantized kernels mid-session — need regression alarms that can auto-fallback.
raj: Operational risk: unexpected cold-start amplification during canary -> overload. Mitigate with gradual ramp and circuit breaker.
annika: I'll ask Acme by EOD whether attestation + NDA is acceptable and confirm AWS CloudHSM vs our KMS preference.
maya: Perfect. Owners:
- Runtime parity & fallback: sam + kevin
- Infra pre-warm & routing: priya + raj
- Security & HSM: laura + legal (TBD)
- Customer comms & acceptance: annika
I'll follow up with a short checklist doc and propose a kickoff tomorrow.
deploy-bot: Note: created ticket INF-8423 for reserved pool provisioning (assigned to priya).
sam: I'll drop the initial parity test harness link here: https://internal.redwood/tests/parity-273
kevin: Putting a quick checklist in the runtime repo and tagging owners.
maya: Thanks everyone — if no objections I'll mark this as high priority and block spot in roadmap for June pilot. Please update your tasks. :thumbsup:
